name: NeMo Gym
summary: NVIDIA Apache-2.0 library for building, evaluating and scaling agent environments, verifiers and harnesses, including sandboxed code-execution tasks.
description: Established NVIDIA project (repo NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym; not archived; created 2025-08-25; not presented as a brand-new 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0. PyPI nemo-gym 0.7.0 verified 2026-11-12 (not yanked; wheel uploaded 2026-10-12; project homepage is this GitHub repo). The official README quick start, however, installs from a git clone with uv venv (Python 3.13.14+) and uv sync, not a pip install one-liner; both facts are recorded. Overview docs at https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/gym/main/about/ (HTTP 200). The get-started path https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/gym/main/get-started responds 307 to /nemo/gym/main/get-started/prerequisites; this entry uses the final URL https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/gym/main/get-started/prerequisites (HTTP 200, no further redirect). README describes environments as a dataset, agent harness, verifier and per-task state, including code execution, tool calling and sandboxes, and optional OpenTelemetry tracing. Quick-start examples use a model API key (OpenAI is the documented example) — no keys were supplied and no environment servers were started. GPU is not required for the library itself; specific resource servers or inference may need one. Vendor: NVIDIA. Related training stack: nemo-rl.

agent_access.notes: Open-source library. README quick start: git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym.git then uv venv --python 3.13.14 && uv sync. PyPI also lists nemo-gym 0.7.0. No API keys were used and no env servers were started.
